summary: Power board with 3.3V input, 1.8V LDO output, and power indicator LED
purpose: Provide regulated 1.8V power from a 3.3V source with status indication
constraints: Regulator must be a fixed 1.8V low-dropout linear regulator
LED must be yellow and connected to the 1.8V rail
LED current must be approximately 1 mA

required.detail: Current-limiting resistor for yellow LED (approx. 1 mA)
